Before reading code, answering questions, or proposing edits, read and strictly follow all binding rules in `prompts/master_system_prompt.md`, `GEMINI.md`, and `AGENTS.md`.

## Quick Non-Negotiables (For Copilot Chat / Inline / Code Review)
- **Startup Check:** On active coding agent tasks, emit `ALIGNED` followed by `PENDING: handoff-<topic>, plan-<topic>` (names only, comma-separated), `EXISTING INCOMPLETE: ...` for files with no open steps, or `NO PENDING WORK` (`docs/plans/`, excluding `suggestions-backlog.md`).
- **Live Hosting Off-Limits:** `release` (and any branch a live site serves), `deploy-pages.yml`, the `release.yml` deploy steps, the Pages source, the custom domain and the `404.html` / site-identity wiring are live in another environment. Never push to, rebase, retarget, disable, delete or "tidy" them unless the request names that thing.
- **React PWA Only:** Core app (`src/`, `index.html`, `vite.config.ts`, `package.json`) MUST stay React + Vite + TypeScript (ES2018). `android-wrapper/` is strictly a thin Kotlin WebView shell—never rewrite the PWA in Kotlin.
- **Three-Layer Boundaries:** `@engine/*` (`src/engine/` — zero livestock/pedigree terms, zero DOM outside `bridge/` & `storage/`), `@features/*` (`src/features/` — zero sibling imports), `@domain/*` (`src/domain/` — pure TS, zero DOM), `@app/*` (`src/app/` — composition root). Never import from `/import/` or `/old/`.
- **Strict Safety & Dates:** Never use `as any`, `@ts-ignore`, or `@ts-expect-error`. Store calendar dates as `"YYYY-MM-DD"` strings (`Date.UTC` arithmetic). Protect `BOOT_ENTRY_LOCK_CHECKSUMS` (`src/main.tsx`, `src/App.tsx`, `index.html`) and `/prompts/`.
- **Verify:** Run `npm run verify` and `npm run build` before completing code changes; log significant changes as a registry entry in `src/domain/improvementRegistry.ts` (`registry-part-*.ts`, with `decidedOn`/`status`/`rejected`) and regenerate the ledger with `npm run regen:ledgers` — never hand-edit the generated ledgers, which `npm run verify` re-renders from the registry. Prompt revisions go in `src/domain/promptRegistry.ts` (`decidedOn` + `version` + `commitShaOrTag`, optional `supersedes`, `supersededBy` when `status: superseded`), regenerated the same way and gated by `npm run verify:prompts` (and both gates run in CI), which reject a half-opted-in entry, a `superseded` with no `supersededBy`, and any new entry outside the pinned `LEGACY_*_ENTRY_IDS` lists that omits the ledger fields; they also reject a `decidedOn` that is not a real calendar date and a `supersededBy` that names no registry entry.
